premises.claims_boundary: RTL-vs-frozen-model must be exact; model-vs-reference is budgeted; nothing here claims synthesis, fit, or audibility

operator_core.gain_ramp: dgain = (gain2 - gain1 + (N >> 1)) >> lg_n, gain += dgain per sample

feedback.algorithm4_algorithm6_serial: inline 3-op / 2-op serial forms, shift min(feedback_shift + 2, 16), skipped ops advance phase by freq << lg_n

envelope.intra_frame_gain: gain2 = ENV_MAX - (level_in >> 14); linear per-sample ramp via dgain

lfo.update_cadence: one getsample + one getdelay per 64-sample frame
lfo.sine_branch: msfa Sin::lookup table (regenerated + pinned at N02)
lfo.keydown_sync: phase_ = (1U << 31) - 1, delaystate_ = 0, only when patch sync set

pitch_env.step: additive level_ +/- inc_ against pitchenv_tab targets

float_gated_reference_spots.model_policy: reproduce float formulas in model; RTL consumes frozen integer results
float_gated_reference_spots.derived_bound: float32 relative error <= 2^-24 on |pb| <= 2^24 => <= +1 logfreq count; dF/F <= ln2 * 2^-22 ~= 1.7e-7

float_gated_reference_spots.cadence: per event/init (osc_freq detune/fine, LFO unit, Freqlut init, sr_multiplier)
float_gated_reference_spots.model_policy: host/control-side float math off the audio frame budget
float_gated_reference_spots.derived_bound: Freqlut regeneration drift <= a few LSB at top entries => <= 1 phase-increment LSB on rare pitches; counted by N02

routing_gating.algorithm_table: 32 entries x 6 packed op descriptors (in_bus/out_bus/add/fb flags)
routing_gating.gate: render only if gain1 <= 16284 or gain2 <= 16284 (Mark I rule)

output.mix: integer sum of clip_val in >= 20 bits; bit-exact vs the reference float mix (each term an integer multiple of 2^-15, |sum| < 2^24 * 2^-15, no -0.0)
output.product_transport: chip hands off clip_val-domain samples; I2S framing owned by H08

event_timing.frame_definition: core render frame = 64 samples = 1.333 ms at 48 kHz
event_timing.policy_string: apply every event with position inside a frame before rendering that frame
event_timing.queue: bounded depth set by H03, never guessed
event_timing.overflow: explicit rejection backpressure, never silent drop
event_timing.reference_alignment: identical to oracle policy (events[evi].pos < i + N applied before block i) and Dexed processBlock block-boundary drain
event_timing.flagged: DEC-014 parenthetical read frame as one sample (20.833 us); this profile fixes frame = 64-sample render block; owner may veto, fallback is a per-sample event shifter in N02

note_tail.reclaimable_predicate: all six operator envelopes: down_ == true AND ix_ == 3 AND level_ == 16 << 16 (clamp floor)
note_tail.reclaim_point: next frame boundary after hold elapses
note_tail.output_neutrality: level_in = 16 << 16 => gain2 = 16368 > k_level_thresh 16284 and gain_out follows => operator gated off (EngineMkI.cpp:314-318); contribution exactly zero
note_tail.louder_release_patches: never satisfy predicate; keep sounding until stolen (DEC-016/017) - valid patch, not an error

clock_12m288.verdict: closes only if shared operator core sustains <= 2.67 clk/op-eval all-in; no margin

clock_24m576.verdict: comfortable at 4-5 clk/eval (~55-70% frame); ss-corner closure unproven per D01 section 2 - H01/H10 must measure

schedule.design_point: 24.576 MHz; 12.288 MHz fallback only if operator core measures <= 2 clk/eval
schedule.correction_note: earlier 213-clk/frame note divided 12.288 MHz by a block rate 64x too high; correct frame rate 750/s => 16384 clk/frame; D01's 256/512 clk are per-sample views of the same arithmetic
schedule.stop_rule: if neither clock closes with the full 16-note schedule, present architecture alternatives to the owner; polyphony (DEC-003) and reference budgets are not relaxation knobs

storage.claim: core replicated runtime state (16 notes x 6 ops) = 38336 bits, member-by-member classified (rev 1.1: v1's 'exact 32416 bits' was a mislabeled subset that omitted FmOpParams.freq/level_in and the per-note derived env params); static patch params excluded from replication (justified member-by-member); all-register estimate 4.5236 mm2 - bounded finding for H02 strengthened
storage.classification_policy: runtime = mutable per note or per op-of-a-note while audio renders, must exist 16x; patch = loaded per patch and identical across all voices of the single-timbre product (the reference copies the same patch bytes into every note, dx7note.cc:163-200), so it may live in one shared patch register file committed at D00 event time; widths = pinned reference type width (32 for int/int32_t accumulators, counters, and derived env params), content width for small bounded fields as stated; trimming below these widths is a later, separately-budgeted decision

per_operator_justification.phase: FmOpParams.phase: per-sample accumulator, advances independently per note (fm_op_kernel.h:20-25, fm_core.cc:133) - runtime
per_operator_justification.freq: FmOpParams.freq: per-note per-frame phase increment, carried across the frame boundary for phase += freq << lg_n (fm_core.cc:133) - runtime; omitted in v1 (judge finding PR #52)
per_operator_justification.gain_out: FmOpParams.gain_out: previous frame env gain, consumed as gain1 next frame (EngineMkI.cpp:314) - runtime
per_operator_justification.level_in: FmOpParams.level_in: current-frame env gain into the op render (EngineMkI.cpp:315) - runtime; omitted in v1
per_operator_justification.env_staticcount: Env.staticcount_ ACCURATE_ENVELOPE hold counter (env.h:73, env.cc:137-141) - runtime
per_operator_justification.env_effective_outlevel: per-note DERIVED, not patch-shared: scaleoutlevel + key-level scaling (midinote) + velocity scaling (dx7note.cc:169-177) differs per note even under one timbre; v1 counted the field but without this derivation justification
per_operator_justification.env_effective_rate_scaling: per-note DERIVED, not patch-shared: ScaleRate(midinote, sensitivity) keyboard rate scaling (dx7note.cc:178)

per_note_justification.basepitch_6: 6 x int32 per-note pitch, midinote-dependent (dx7note.cc:185-187) - runtime
per_note_justification.fb_buf_2: 2 x int32 feedback history (dx7note.h:77, NUM-006) - runtime
per_note_justification.noteLogFreq: note-on log frequency incl. tuning (dx7note.cc:154-161) - runtime
per_note_justification.mpe_fields: per-note MPE expression: mpePitchBend 0..16383 (14), mpePressure/mpeTimbre 0..127 (7+7) (dx7note.h:68-70, PluginProcessor.h:48-50) - runtime
per_note_justification.steal_rotation_age: voice allocator bookkeeping estimate, unchanged from v1 (18 = 3 flags + 15 age/rotation)

patch_shared_justification.env_rates_4_x6ops: raw 0..99 rates; the same patch bytes are copied into every note (dx7note.cc:165-167) - one shared copy
patch_shared_justification.env_levels_4_x6ops: raw 0..99 levels; per-note divergence enters only through the derived outlevel/rate_scaling counted as runtime
patch_shared_justification.fb_depth: patch[135], fb_shift_ derived once per patch (dx7note.cc:196-197) - patch
patch_shared_justification.mod_depths_and_sens: pitchmoddepth_/pitchmodsens_/ampmoddepth_ derived once from patch bytes (dx7note.cc:198-200) - patch

excluded_not_state: currentPatch: pointer into the shared patch buffer, not replicated state
tuning_state_/mtsFreq/mtsClient: single fixed tuning in the pinned configuration (R01 settings[tuning]); MTS absent so mtsFreq = 0 (dx7note.cc:154-161)
raw velocity: consumed once at note-on into the per-note effective outlevel (dx7note.cc:176), not needed to render
VoiceStatus (dx7note.h:34-38): UI status snapshot via peekVoiceStatus, not render state
